pointwise mutual information.reason: RESOLVED against sec3.2.2 eq (4), read directly from the paper: ddG(x,y) = -k_B T[(log p_theta(y|x) - log p_phi(y)) - (log p_theta(y_wt|x) - log p_phi(y_wt))]. The inner bracket is log-conditional minus log-unconditional over the SAME sequence y -- pointwise mutual information by definition. No 1/L averaging; the subtrahend is the same sequence's prior, not a background sequence's; p_phi is the same network with coordinate channels masked, so 'self-derived' holds. The paper confirms the reading without naming it: 'Subtracting log p_phi(y) from log p_theta(y|x) removes background amino-acid composition and chain-length preferences, isolating backbone-specific excess compatibility' -- excess over background is what PMI measures. named_in_paper: false is correct. ROLE OMITS two things, noted not penalised: the wild-type anchoring (it is a difference of TWO PMIs, which is what makes it a double difference) and the -k_B T scaling. Everything the role states is true. BONUS: p_phi being the same network makes the reward wholly internal to the model being trained -- limitations bullet 2's self-reinforcing-bias concern is sharper than the card knew, and open_questions bullet 1 lands squarely.

diversity regularization.reason: [source] Q1, Q10 ('diversity-promoting regularizer based on protein embeddings that effectively prevents mode collapse'), Q13 ('operates in the model's representation space rather than on sequences directly'). conditional generative model.reason: [source] sec3.1: 'typically formulate this as a conditional generation task, where a model p_theta(y|x)'. Aliases all genuine: 'inverse folding model' is what it is here, 'structure-conditioned sequence distribution' is a clean synonym.

THE FIRST CLEAR WIN IN FOUR CARDS, and it is the highest-value output the system produces. Object 5 claims named_in_paper: false for pointwise mutual information behind the ddG surrogate. Confirmed against sec3.2.2 eq (4): the inner bracket is log p_theta(y|x) - log p_phi(y) over the same sequence -- PMI by definition -- and the paper's own gloss ('removes background amino-acid composition and chain-length preferences, isolating backbone-specific excess compatibility') describes what PMI measures without ever naming it. The curator recovered an unnamed mathematical object correctly. One positive data point on curator inference, and it is the case invariant 15 exists for.

ROLE GAP (not penalised): the role describes only the inner PMI term, omitting the wild-type anchoring that makes eq (4) a difference of two PMIs, and the -k_B T scaling. Also unknown to the card and sharpening its own limitations bullet 2: p_phi is the SAME network with coordinate channels masked, so the stability reward is wholly internal to the model being trained.
